<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `VALIDATION_FAILED (literal, 50 pages)`
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **19** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `12456a1d04fed52173507024ab936906ef8bae86` — the merge of head `05e98ac3f560bafb35549c625b6811ade7e0a1ee` into base `f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 12456a1d04fed52173507024ab936906ef8bae86 && git checkout 12456a1d04fed52173507024ab936906ef8bae86
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587 05e98ac3f560bafb35549c625b6811ade7e0a1ee && git checkout -B drift-repro f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587 && git merge --no-ff 05e98ac3f560bafb35549c625b6811ade7e0a1ee

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`POST /api/v1/batch`（跨对象批量）请求体不合 schema 时，400 VALIDATION_FAILED 的回答从原样透出 zod `issues` 改为 ADR-0114 的 `fields[]`（`{ field, code, message }`），和同文件里单对象批量入口一致；`issues` 键不再出现在这个回答里。
- 为什么改：客户端 `err.fields` 在这个入口一直是空的，只能去解析 zod 内部结构；ADR-0114 D3 规定 zod 在边界映射、不透传。
- 风险与回滚：只影响这一个拒收分支的回答体，状态码、`code`、成功路径都不变。仓内没有客户端、SDK、测试或文档读这里的 `issues`；changeset 写明了 `issues[i].path` → `fields[i].field` 的迁移。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts` 308–322 行。
- 两分钟验证：以管理员 `POST /api/v1/batch` 发 `{"operations":"x"}`，回答 400 且带 `fields`、不带 `issues`。
- 需要你做的：无，区内落地（非受管面、137 行）。L1 意见：去掉 `issues` 可以，并且应当去掉（见下「裁定」），可落。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a) · repo:objectstack#5 · head `05e98ac3f560bafb35549c625b6811ade7e0a1ee` · 2026-11-19T01:45Z

- **形态:** draft → `main`, 3 files, +135/−2, 3 commits (test, fix, one merge of `origin/main`). `Fixes #34863` on the first content line; no other card number beside a closing keyword. `check-governed-merges --pr 35277`: 0 of 3 paths governed, 137 lines ≤ 3000 → ordinary queue landing. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **裁定 — dropping `issues` (asked by the area):** accepted, and keeping it would have been the defect. (1) ADR-0114 D3: "Zod is mapped at the boundary, never passed through". A raw `issues` beside `fields` is exactly the passthrough D3 forbids. (2) Every other batch door in the same file (`/data/:object/batch`, `createMany`, `updateMany`, `deleteMany`) answers `fields` with no `issues`, so this aligns the one outlier. (3) `issues` is declared nowhere for this refusal: `ApiErrorSchema` declares neither key, `@objectstack/spec/api` exports no cross-object batch error schema, and the body is an untyped `res.json` literal absent from `dist/index.d.ts` (dev reading). Removing an undeclared key that the published ADR text already negates pulls the door back to its declared contract, so `Clause-②: no` is the right declaration (execution-duties: pulling back to a declared contract does not touch Clause-②; the `no` must cite that text, and the changeset cites ADR-0114 D3). (4) Readers: L1 re-checked on this head: no `issues` reader of this refusal in `packages/client/src`, no batch `issues` in `content/docs/protocol/kernel/http-protocol.mdx`. The changeset still carries the FROM → TO line for any outside caller.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/34863-cross-object-batch-refusal-fields.md`, `patch` on `@objectstack/rest` (published). Sentences read against the diff and the new test: `{"operations":"x"}` → `operations`/`invalid_type`, `{}` → `operations`/`required`, missing object → `operations.0.object`/`required` (all three pinned); "the same list … the per-object batch doors answer" matches the shared `zodIssuesToFields(issues, input)` call; "A client's `err.fields` is now filled on this door too": L1 read the client's error path, which takes a top-level `errorBody.fields` array, so the benefit crosses the HTTP boundary as claimed.
- **差异由 L1 读过:** one hunk in `batch-routes.ts`; the parsed input is kept in `batchInput` so `zodIssuesToFields` can split `invalid_type` from `required` (ADR-0114 D3's parsed-input rule); status, `code`, `error` text unchanged.
- **Pins:** new file `cross-object-batch-request-refusal-fields.test.ts`, three cases, each asserting `status` 400 and `code` `VALIDATION_FAILED` (ADR-0112 envelope), every `fields` element parses against `FieldErrorSchema`, no `issues` key, and no transaction or insert reached. Red leg against the pre-fix source: 3/3 red with the card's reproduction body byte for byte; restored blob == HEAD.
- **门禁:** check-runs on head `05e98ac3`: 37 success, 16 skipped (UI families and opt-ins), 0 failure. Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core (10/10 shards), Build Core, Check Changeset, Flag docs affected all `success`. Dev local NOT MEASURED `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` is covered by CI's Lint families on this head.
- **接受的偏差:** none. (The card asked only for `fields[]`; the removal of `issues` is ruled above.)
- **范围外去向:** none reported; #9559 (envelope position) untouched, as the body says.
- **落地条款:** K = 2 first-parent commits on `main` since merge base `e8a78c4b` (< 15), no locale pack. Non-governed ⇒ ux-3 lands per `landing-operations.md` (`pr_ready` + auto-merge) after this ACCEPT; on MERGED, close-out on #34863.
